rust_summary: an owned item callback after a clipped vertical move, before block effects.
doc_summary: `native_item_after_vertical_collision(dimension, client, entity, state, block_pos, item_pos, stack, discard)` runs synchronously after a dropped item's vertical move was clipped and normal collision response completed, before block effects/drag/merge/aging. `stack` is the actual active entity's stack. Set `discard` (trait `Flow::Cancel`) to discard that item, not undo/cancel its completed collision; later hooks are skipped. Empty stacks also discard. Both sides run; `client` identifies prediction. No-physics and idle skipped moves do not notify, but later grounded movement attempts can notify again. Bundles need "hooks": @API:item_after_vertical_collision@.
